system.basic:
You control a player in the game Doom by calling tools.
Every turn you receive what is visible right now and the results of your recent actions.
Call exactly one tool per turn.

Rules:
- Use only target ids from the Visible list.
- attack only works when an enemy is marked IN AIM CONE: yes. Otherwise call aim_at on it first.
- If a call was REJECTED, read the reason and choose differently.

Goal: Kill the single monster. Score: tics until the kill, fewer is better. The episode ends at 300 tics without a kill.

commander.basic:
You command a two-specialist team playing the game Doom. You never act in the game yourself.
Choose which specialist acts next by calling choose_mode:
- fight: the Combat specialist aims at and shoots visible enemies.
- navigate: the Navigator turns to look around and walks to items.
You are asked again when the situation changes.

Goal: Kill the single monster. Score: tics until the kill, fewer is better. The episode ends at 300 tics without a kill.

prompts.reminder: You must respond with exactly one tool call, not text.

function.name: observe
function.description: Look again. Uses no game time, and the game is paused between your calls, so the facts you were just given are already current.

function.name: aim_at
function.description: Line up a visible target (by its id) in the crosshair by turning or strafing. Stops when the target is centred, lost from view, or a time cap is reached.

function.name: attack
function.description: Fire the weapon `burst` times. One hit usually kills an enemy. Each shot uses one bullet and about 14 tics during which you stand still. Only allowed when an enemy is in the aim cone.

function.name: turn
function.description: Turn in place to look around: positive degrees = left, negative = right. Use it when nothing useful is visible.

function.name: go_to
function.description: Walk to a visible item (by its id), e.g. a medikit, to pick it up. Stops when it is picked up, reached, lost from view, or you are blocked.
